## Checklist

- [ ] No text copied from the SRE books; ideas are in my own words with chapter citations.
- [ ] Any adapted third-party material is credited (in the file and in `NOTICE`) and its license allows reuse.
- [ ] Risky commands are marked ⚠️ with what they affect and how to undo them.
- [ ] `python3 tools/check_skill.py` and `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` pass.
- [ ] If I changed the calculator, I added or updated a test.
- [ ] If I changed `SKILL.md` behaviour, I added or updated an eval case and tried it with an agent.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased" (for user-facing changes).
